title: GTA 6's Key Cloner in 3 Steps
short_title_options: You can't buy GTA 6's key cloner #GTA6 #Shorts
How to steal any car in GTA 6 (key cloner) #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
How to get and use GTA 6's key cloner: you can't buy it. 1) It unlocks in a story mission for Randy (Chapter 3 in most guides). 2) Scan a car with the WAiNK app on your phone to see if it needs a cloned key or has a tracker. 3) At the driver's door, pick Clone Key and fill the meter. Pricey cars carry trackers, so cloning gets you in, not off the radar. Light on spoilers.

Sources: GameSpot, GamesRadar, VICE.
